attributes.action: Review KS3 & 4 English literature curriculum to create a more diverse curriculum
attributes.additional_details:
We believe schools should provide better exposure to the rest of the World, and we feel that without a diverse curriculum, pupils may lack knowledge and have a narrow vision of the different cultures, societies and histories.
 
We believe that by implementing a more diverse curriculum in a multicultural country (which includes a variety of different faiths and languages) could lead to a more inclusive environment, reduce racism and prejudice, and leads to students having more empathy and understanding of other backgrounds. This could foster more unity and inclusivity in our communities. Would you want to be ignorant about the world around you?
attributes.background: We want the Government to review the current English literature curriculum in secondary schools to create a more diverse curriculum, with works and texts from different parts of the World.
